skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Search/filter · install/uninstall · enable/disable · consistent feedback.
skills.cliMissingBanner: OpenClaw CLI was not detected: the local skills list depends on the CLI. With the built-in chat engine enabled, Chat does not require the CLI.
skills.builtinChatOk: Built-in chat works; configure the OpenClaw executable in Global settings to manage skills.
skills.marketSectionSub: Browse a controlled HTTPS index; install still runs via OpenClaw CLI. Falls back to a bundled catalog if the network fails.
skills.marketSourceHint: Data source: by default we fetch this repo’s index from GitHub Raw; if that’s unreachable, we automatically try jsDelivr (same JSON, often easier from China). If both fail, the bundled catalog is used. You can also set CLAWFLOW_SKILL_MARKET_URL to a self-hosted JSON (e.g. on Gitee) and CLAWFLOW_SKILL_MARKET_EXTRA_HOSTS for extra allowed hostnames.
skills.marketEmpty: No marketplace items or no search matches.
skills.emptySub: Adjust your search, or reset filters below.
skills.emptyLocalSub: The OpenClaw CLI returned no installed skills. Install from the marketplace below, then refresh.

states.toastErrBody: Check dependencies or network, then retry.

settings.title: Global settings
settings.subtitle: App-wide preferences and OpenClaw. Pick a section on the left, edit details on the right. Saving applies globally (except workspace chat files, which stay per workspace folder).
settings.subtitleSplit: Choose a section on the left. Use Save settings to persist CLI paths, timeouts, and other global prefs. Chat history stays under each workspace `.clawflow/` folder.
settings.globalScopeStripe: All items on this page are global — changes apply to the entire app everywhere (each workspace still keeps its own chats and attachments).
settings.cliPathMissingDetail: OpenClaw CLI is not installed or not on PATH.
settings.openclawCliVersionHint: If the CLI is unavailable, set the executable path below.
settings.savedBody: Preferences stored locally; OpenClaw settings synced to engine when possible.
settings.modelsHint: Chat always uses the ClawFlow built-in multi-provider engine. Browse the catalog below and save provider API keys (OpenClaw-compatible local auth store read by the main process).
settings.modelsLocalHint: Local storage: tokens live under `.clawflow/openclaw/agents/main/agent/auth-profiles.json` (or an equivalent mirrored store), shared across workspaces, and can be deleted anytime.
settings.apiKeysSectionLead: Choose a provider and paste your API key or token, then save. Keys are stored in the built-in auth file and apply to chat immediately.
settings.builtinModelsHint: Built-in chat models; availability follows the keys saved above, or env vars (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).
settings.builtinCatalogEmpty: Could not load the built-in catalog (or it is empty). Check that the main process exposes the engine IPC.
settings.builtinSuggestedDefault: When nothing else is picked, built-in prefers: {{model}}
settings.builtinChatPickerHint: Per-chat model picks override this; switch models from the Chat page dropdown.
settings.modelsKeysUnifiedHint: Supports DeepSeek, OpenAI, and Anthropic. Tokens are not shown in full after saving.
settings.modelSavedLocal: Token saved locally for this provider
settings.modelDeleteConfirm: This will delete the locally saved token for this provider. Continue?
settings.addProviderHint: Pick a provider and paste a token; saving refreshes the catalog availability above.
settings.modelRemoveStaleConfirm: We will switch the default (if needed), remove this id from fallbacks/aliases via CLI where possible, and clear any matching manual provider token. Continue?
settings.modelRemoveBlockedOnlyBody: This is the only model entry available to fall back on. Configure/save another model first, then remove this one.
settings.modelRowRemovedBody: The configuration was refreshed to drop or adjust this entry.
settings.modelRowRemovedPartialBody: Default was switched and we attempted cleanup; if the row still appears, check `openclaw models list/status` — it may remain in upstream catalog/state.
settings.modelMissingKeyTitle: Provider {{provider}} has no API key/token configured
settings.modelProfileNameHint: Optional label for this token (you can save multiple profiles per provider and switch the active one).

settings.modelProfileRenamePrompt: Enter a new profile name (leave empty to clear):
settings.modelEnvHint_personal: Tags this key profile for personal use (organizational / mental model only).
settings.modelEnvHint_work: Tags this key profile for work use; keep separate from personal keys.
settings.modelEnvHint_custom: Custom environment label for your own grouping of keys and models.
settings.providerHintDeepseek: Uses DeepSeek’s API; create keys in the DeepSeek console.
settings.providerHintOpenai: Uses OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible API; create keys on the provider side.
settings.providerHintAnthropic: Uses Anthropic Claude API; create keys in the Anthropic console.
settings.logLevelHint_debug: Most verbose logging; best for debugging (highest volume).
settings.logLevelHint_info: Standard operational messages; recommended for daily use.
settings.logLevelHint_warn: Warnings and errors only; quieter logs.
settings.modePolicyHint: Optional. Override ask/plan/multitask parameters via JSON (thinking/jsonMode/effort). Saved policy will apply to each request.

settings.modelProviderHint: Choose which provider you want to use for Chat.
